summary:
I used the last allowed build attempt and still could not publish a validated package.

What changed in the last attempt
- Kept the persisted `game/state/CMakeLists.txt` cross-build patch.
- Replaced the missing host C++ generator binaries with host-side Python scripts that emulate:
  - `OpenApoc_GamestateSerializeGen`
  - `OpenApoc_LuaGamestateSupportGen`
- Kept the manual PhysFS static-library workaround to avoid the bundled PhysFS subproject’s `cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.30)`.

What that proved
- The prior hard blockers were worked around successfully:
  - no host C++ compiler for generator tools
  - ARM64 generator executables not runnable on the host
  - PhysFS subproject requiring newer CMake
- The build got far past generation:
  - both generated files were produced
  - the main ARM64 build progressed to `167/271`
- It then failed only because the build attempt hit the tool’s 6-minute wall:
  - `Build attempt exceeded six minutes.`

So the current blocker is now:
- attempt budget exhausted, and
- the last recipe still built too much within the per-attempt time limit.

Most likely next recipe improvement
- Build only the game target instead of the default `all` target:
  - use `cmake --build build --target OpenApoc -j...`
- That should avoid unnecessary work and likely fit under the timeout.
- I cannot try it now because this session’s final allowed build attempt has already been consumed.

Controller support conclusion
- `api=keyboard`
- `support=unsupported`

Why
- `framework/framework.cpp:543` handles `SDL_KEYDOWN`
- `framework/framework.cpp:544` creates `KeyboardEvent(EVENT_KEY_DOWN)`
- `framework/framework.cpp:545` binds `e.key.keysym.sym`
- `framework/framework.cpp:539-541` shows joystick device events are ignored (`// FIXME: Do nothing?`)
- I did not find a usable SDL gamepad binding path for the observed RG CubeXX controller’s 4 axes / 17 buttons / hat.

Graphics caution
- Not runtime-verified.
- The source still appears Linux/GLX-oriented in the renderer setup, while the handheld profile is framebuffer/EGL/GLES without X11. Even after a successful compile, graphics compatibility may still need platform adaptation.

Net result
- No validated package was produced.
- The remaining blocker is not a missing dependency anymore; it is the exhausted attempt budget after a build-time timeout.
